description: Re-runs L3 brief generation for a single brief (scoped to its cluster). Typically takes ~2–5 min. Async — returns `{operationId, status}`. Poll `get_job` with the operationId until `state` is `completed` (or `failed`/`partially_failed`/`cancelled` on error), then re-fetch with seo_get_brief to see the refreshed briefData. Use when the existing brief's outline is unusable and a structured seo_edit_brief won't recover it.

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Wins over the brief's cluster's own language for this regeneration. Omit to regenerate in the cluster's existing language.

name: seo_regenerate_brief
